items.title: fix(api): restore Node test discovery (#13375)
items.body:
## Summary

Closes #13375.

The root `npm test` command delegates to the API workspace, whose existing test script passes `src/tests` as a directory argument to Node's test runner.

This can cause a module-resolution error instead of discovering and executing the existing test files.

## Changes

Update the API workspace test script:

```diff
- "test": "node --test src/tests"
+ "test": "node --test"
```

Node's built-in test runner can then discover the existing test files automatically.

## Scope

Only `apps/api/package.json` is changed.

No application logic, dependencies, package identity, or other scripts are modified.

## Validation

The creator-owned issue #13375 documents prior local Node 22 validation:

- Original command failed before executing the health test.
- Modified command passed the existing health test.
- A separate temporary test-discovery check also passed.

These are historical local results, not independent verification of the submitted commit.

Full upstream CI remains pending. This submission is a draft until its final HEAD is validated.

## Bounty Eligibility

This submission follows the creator-owned issue procedure described in #11398.

Similar fixes have been proposed elsewhere in the repository. Maintainers should determine whether this contribution remains eligible and confirm the applicable reward independently.

This contribution was prepared with AI assistance.

No merge, award, or payment is claimed.
